1 For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. (2 Corinthians 5:1 KJV)

This â€œearthly houseâ€ that Paul is referring to is our human bodies, which are the tabernacle of God to all those that are born again (1 Corinthians 3:16). He is saying that when we die we will receive a new house (body) made by God, and it will be eternal. This is our glorified bodies that we have been promised when we are saved, and which we will receive when we see Jesus face to face (1 Corinthians 13:12), upon His return to receive us into Heaven.

All Christians should have the mindset that we are just visitors on earth, as when we were born again, we became citizens of Heaven through being in the body of Christ. We have been given citizenship in Heaven, and at the same time have been blessed with all Spiritual blessings in heavenly places (Ephesians 1:3), right now on earth. If a Christian could just understand what this means, they would be able to experience the victorious life that God intends us to have right now, here on earth, and not just when we get to Heaven. Thank you Jesus for all you have done for us and thank you Father for your Grace and Mercy and most of all your Love.
